lines.say: Myth: rereading your notes the night before is revision.
Fact: rereading feels good because it's familiar. Familiar isn't remembered.
Myth: if you can blurt it, you know it.
Fact: blurting is half of it. The other half is checking what you missed.
Offload does the other half for you: you blurt, then it shows you what you missed.
It plans your revision too. You just click the link in your calendar.
So. Myth or fact: rereading is revision?
